strings.english: An ancient grain that thrives in harsh conditions, it can be harvested to brew beer and make simple meals
strings.lookup_english: An ancient grain that thrives in harsh conditions, it can be harvested to brew beer and make simple meals
strings.spanish: Un grano antiguo que prospera en condiciones difíciles y que se puede cosechar para elaborar cerveza y preparar comidas sencillas.
strings.chinese: 一种在恶劣条件下也能茁壮成长的古老谷物，可以收获来酿造啤酒和制作简单膳食。

strings.english: Tall gold that drinks the sun, slow to rise but heavy in the hand when harvest comes
strings.lookup_english: Tall gold that drinks the sun, slow to rise but heavy in the hand when harvest comes
strings.spanish: Oro en forma de cultivo que bebe del sol, lento al nacer pero pesado en la mano cuando llega la cosecha.
strings.chinese: 畅饮阳光的高大金穗，长得慢，但到了收获时节，握在手里沉甸甸的。

strings.english: Pale clusters for the table, sweet enough to eat from the vine before anyone thinks of the press
strings.lookup_english: Pale clusters for the table, sweet enough to eat from the vine before anyone thinks of the press
strings.spanish: Pálidos racimos para la mesa, lo bastante dulces para comerlos de la vid antes de que nadie piense en el lagar.
strings.chinese: 端上餐桌的浅色葡萄串，甜得还没人想到拿去榨汁，就已经直接从藤上摘来吃了。

strings.english: Quick leaves that ask little of the soil, more refreshment than a meal, and gone before you notice
strings.lookup_english: Quick leaves that ask little of the soil, more refreshment than a meal, and gone before you notice
strings.spanish: Hojas rápidas que le piden poco al suelo, más refresco que comida, y desaparecen antes de que te des cuenta.
strings.chinese: 长得飞快的叶子，对土壤要求不高，与其说是一顿饭，不如说是爽口小菜，一不留神就没了。

strings.english: A buried fortune that fattens a village, humble in the dirt and stubborn against hunger
strings.lookup_english: A buried fortune that fattens a village, humble in the dirt and stubborn against hunger
strings.spanish: Una fortuna enterrada que engorda a un pueblo, humilde en la tierra y terca contra el hambre.
strings.chinese: 埋在地下的财富，能把一村人喂得饱饱的；在泥土里朴实无华，对抗饥饿却顽强不屈。

strings.english: Dark bunches meant for the cup as much as the plate, slower to ripen and richer when they do
strings.lookup_english: Dark bunches meant for the cup as much as the plate, slower to ripen and richer when they do
strings.spanish: Racimos oscuros pensados tanto para la copa como para el plato, más lentos al madurar y más ricos cuando lo hacen.
strings.chinese: 深色的葡萄串，既能入杯也能上盘，成熟得更慢，熟透时滋味也更浓。

strings.english: A thirsty grain that feeds whole nations; patient in the paddy and generous at the table
strings.lookup_english: A thirsty grain that feeds whole nations; patient in the paddy and generous at the table
strings.spanish: Un grano sediento que alimenta naciones enteras; paciente en el arrozal y generoso en la mesa.
strings.chinese: 离不开水的谷物，养活了一个又一个国家；在稻田里耐心生长，在餐桌上慷慨馈赠。

strings.english: A hardy grain that keeps growing when the soil has given up, dark in the loaf and stubborn in the field
strings.lookup_english: A hardy grain that keeps growing when the soil has given up, dark in the loaf and stubborn in the field
strings.spanish: Un grano resistente que sigue creciendo cuando el suelo se ha rendido, oscuro en el pan y terco en el campo.
strings.chinese: 坚韧的谷物，连土壤都放弃了，它还在生长；做成面包颜色深沉，长在田里倔强不屈。

strings.english: A vine that wants staking and sun, yielding fruit that sits between garden and orchard
strings.lookup_english: A vine that wants staking and sun, yielding fruit that sits between garden and orchard
strings.spanish: Una vid que pide tutor y sol, y da un fruto que se sienta entre el huerto y el vergel.
strings.chinese: 需要搭架和阳光的藤蔓，结出的果实介于菜园与果园之间。

strings.english: Mankind's oldest crop, it can be harvested to make bread and feed your people easily
strings.lookup_english: Mankind's oldest crop, it can be harvested to make bread and feed your people easily
strings.spanish: El cultivo más antiguo de la humanidad, se puede cosechar para hacer pan y alimentar a tu gente fácilmente.
strings.chinese: 人类最古老的作物，可以收获来制作面包，轻松养活你的人民
